newsitem.title: USA: Airborne in South Africa joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Airborne in South Africa joint venture.

text.p: Airborne Express said it has set up a South African joint venture named Airborne Express South Africa Ltd, formerly known as Ribbon Technologies.
"Stability of the Mandela administration has encouraged continued investment by American, Asian, and European multi-national corporations," said Konrad Peter, of Airborne Express South Africa.
The company has 37 employees and 13 trucks operating out of offices in Johannesburg, Durban, and Cape Town.
Its 2,500 square-metre distribution warehouse is located in Johannesburg.
It said by late 1997 it would open satellite offices in Port Elizabeth, East London and Bloemfontein.
Peter said that currently the majority of the company's business is generated by electronic and pharmaceutical industries.
"Since the 1996 opening of operations in South Africa, shipments have increased 118 percent," he said.
